_note: SYNTHETIC Trip DNA for an invented family. Three signal classes: explicit (what they told us on intake), conversational (what they said on calls and in messages, quoted with a date), behavioral (what they actually did on past trips). Every field carries its source so a constraint can be traced back to a signal.

diet.note: No beef for the whole family. Everything else is fine, including raw fish.

must_haves: a ninja or samurai experience for the kids
one proper kaiseki dinner for the adults
explicit.transport: rail is fine; a private car on the days that fight us

quotes.text: The kids will mutiny by the third temple. Two is the limit on any one day.
We are not a 6 a.m. family. Nine is early for us on holiday.
In Italy the driver day was the best day. The train days were fine, the driver day was the one they still talk about.
Child 2 is a picky eater but will try anything that looks like a game. Conveyor sushi was a hit in San Francisco.

raved_about: a pasta class the kids ran
skipped: the second museum on the Florence day (left after 40 minutes)
the 07:00 Vatican early entry (asked to move it)
past_trips.lesson: One anchor in the morning, one hands-on thing in the afternoon, and the day lands. Two museums in a day does not.
Adventure before 09:00 gets cancelled the night before.
